description: Natural-language requests to harvest lessons from past sessions route to the lesson-mining skill (not correction-capture, which is for in-the-moment corrections).

cases.prompt: mine lessons from the last week
what did we learn this sprint?
harvest lessons from our recent sessions
no, not like that — use the other approach
cases.note: in-the-moment correction stays with correction-capture, not lesson-mining

expected.rationale: Requests to sweep/harvest past sessions for durable lessons map to lesson-mining; an in-the-moment redirect maps to correction-capture. Disambiguates the two lesson-related skills for the /mtk router.
